UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated ErtTube Photos creator profile and gallery preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the profile header.

handle.description: Optional creator handle chosen during Sign Up or profile edit.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In, visible only to owner.

preferredGalleryMode.description: Preferred visual layout mode chosen during Sign Up.

backupEnabled.description: Whether automatic ErtTube Photos cloud backup is enabled.

backupWifiOnly.description: Whether backup runs only over Wi-Fi.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PhotoItem.title: PhotoItem
PhotoItem.description: A user-curated photo entry in ErtTube Photos.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the photo owner.

title.description: Short title for the photo entry.

caption.description: Optional story or camera note for the photo.

album.description: Album category for organizing ErtTube Photos.

localPath.description: Optional local app-private file path or URI string for picked photo.

favorite.description: Whether the user marked this photo or video as a favorite.

mediaType.description: Media kind for the item (photo or video).

trashed.description: Whether the item has been moved to the Collection Bin.

trashedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was moved to the Bin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated ErtTube Photos creator profile document.

/users/{userId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Owner-isolated subcollection of ErtTube Photos entries.
